purpose: GPT5-B3 BLOCKER truth-audit: canonical-N pseudo-C_l and decoupled C_l recompute with PROPER galaxy-weighted monopole subtraction vs paper's existing implicit subtraction (= 0). Determines whether the +1.85sigma canonical-mask post-MASTER residual is primarily explained by improper monopole removal.

_provenance.audit_origin: P4 internal R-round on v1.0.104 caught GPT5-B3 BLOCKER: paper defines NaMaster input field as f_CW(p) - 0.5 (line 4163) but observed global f_CW = 0.49735, leaving -0.00265 residual monopole (= -0.0053 in asymmetry units). Paper script canonical_l1_namaster_pod.py uses A_p = (CW-CCW)/total directly without explicit mean subtraction.
_provenance.recompute_script: /tmp/quick_audit.py on pod ijzftpy3klystt (uses pymaster 2.6 + healpy 1.19 + catalog_production.parquet)

config._note: A_gw = (sum n_total*A) / sum(n_total) = 2*f_CW - 1 exactly, confirming the residual monopole is the catalog's intrinsic CW excess

monopole_correction_impact.interpretation: Monopole correction reduces pseudo-C_0 by 331x (=the leakage source) but reduces decoupled C_1 by only 4.6%. The +1.85sigma canonical post-MASTER residual is NOT primarily explained by improper monopole subtraction. If null_mean and null_std are unchanged after monopole correction in the MC shuffle, the new sigma would be approximately 1.85 * 0.954 = 1.77sigma, still failing the |sigma|<1 criterion. GPT5-B3 BLOCKER is METHODOLOGICALLY CORRECT (paper should subtract <A>_mask explicitly) but the magnitude is small.

verdict.GPT5_B3_methodology_claim: CORRECT — paper's NaMaster input field lacks explicit mask-weighted-mean subtraction
verdict.GPT5_B3_magnitude_claim: OVERSTATED — leak into l=1 is ~5%, not the dominant source of +1.85sigma residual
verdict.Grok_B1_canonical_residual: STILL UNRESOLVED — the +1.85sigma persists at ~1.77sigma after proper monopole subtraction; a real systematic at canonical-mask level remains
verdict.recommendation_for_v1_0_106: (1) Update paper text + script to use galaxy-weighted mask-mean subtraction explicitly. (2) Document the 5% magnitude effect honestly. (3) Note that Grok-B1 canonical-mask injection-recovery sweep is still required to bound the residual systematic.

expected_corrected_sigma_estimate.method: Approximate via decoupled C_1 ratio assuming null_mean and null_std unchanged
expected_corrected_sigma_estimate.caveat: Full MC null with proper subtraction is needed for the exact new sigma; this estimate assumes null statistics are unchanged. Full 500-realization MC is queued for v1.0.106+ on pod.
